intro: Sally Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron.

p: Sally Whitemane spent her youth in Southshore alongside childhood companions Renault Mograine and James Vishas. That innocence vanished during the Third War when her family traveled north through Lordaeron and succumbed to the plague of undeath. Forced to personally put down her own parents and siblings after they rose as mindless Scourge minions, Whitemane was left consumed by guilt, grief, and unyielding rage. From that day onward, she dedicated her life solely to eradicating undeath in all its forms.

Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she led relief forces to rescue Hearthglen from the Scourge and stood as a guiding hand during the induction of high-ranking Crusaders like Taelan Fordring. Her absolute conviction has made her one of the Crusade's foremost symbols, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.
